headline: Asian Chipmakers and Data Centre Suppliers Slide Following US Tech Rout
summary: Asian chipmakers and data center equipment suppliers across South Korea, Taiwan, and Japan faced sharp declines following the technology sector sell-off in US markets.
why: Asian semiconductor foundries and hardware manufacturers serve as core supply chain partners for global technology firms, rendering them vulnerable to shifts in US tech sentiment.

impacts.name: Technology Sector
impacts.why: Asian hardware suppliers fell in sympathy with the US tech stock rout.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Asian component suppliers dropped as regional markets tracked the severe tech sell-off originating on Wall Street.
